_comment: Drives bltouch.test under the simavr bridge. The test homes X/Y/Z (Z via the bltouch probe), exercises BLTOUCH_DEBUG/reset, runs BED_MESH_CALIBRATE (many probe points), then a single PROBE + QUERY_PROBE. The bridge's BLTouch state machine handles the deploy/arm cycle on PC5/PC7; auto_trigger_after_steps fires the sensor pin to triggered after 800 edges on the Z step pin (PL3) and the bridge's auto-rearm logic re-arms it on the BLTouch's between-probe sensor reset, so multi-point bed_mesh probing succeeds.
